🖥️ Check Your Local GPU in Terminal (Zero-Install CLI)

Zero Dependencies · Python 3

Auto-detects your NVIDIA GPU (nvidia-smi) or Apple Silicon Unified Memory and prints which Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Gemma, and Mistral models fit—with exact ollama run and vllm serve commands. Supports --vram 24 --ctx 32768 --live.

Linux / macOS (Terminal)
curl -sL https://stigla610.github.io/ai-cost-engine/tokenbench.py | python3 -
Windows (PowerShell)
irm https://stigla610.github.io/ai-cost-engine/tokenbench.py | python -
